game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the smelter.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the smelter. Each round, ember hounds strike the smelter, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the smelter from ember hounds in Charred Forest: keep the power_on meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: power_on drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while power_on > 0.
